text:
evan_support: Heads-up — Pro customer opened ticket #5891: /v1/rerank returns 413 and the body is just plain text "Payload Too Large". They can't tell if this is tokens, chars, or doc count.

sophie_engineer: Which endpoint exactly and can you share counts (bytes, docs, avg len)?

evan_support: /v1/rerank. payload ~1.6MB, docs=140, avg passage ~850 chars, query ~1.2k chars. Response body: "413 Payload Too Large" no JSON.

qa_jordan: I reproduced in prod-repro. Gateway log shows a rejection with tag RERANK_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-10T09:18:02Z ERROR gateway: reject code=413 tag=RERANK_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE acct=acct-ACME-123 payload_bytes=1678342 doc_count=140 chars_total=120456
```
We currently reject early at the gateway input guard to avoid runtime OOM during pairwise scoring.

ashwin_infra: Current rule is: reject if aggregated_chars > 100000 OR doc_count > 100. It's intentionally conservative because rerank does pairwise comparisons and memory usage grows quickly. We don't include which threshold fired in the 413 today — just plain text.

sophie_engineer: Short-term priorities:
1) Support copy that explains the limits and gives practical workarounds.
2) Infra change to return structured JSON on 413 with counts and limits so customers get actionable feedback.

evan_support: Draft reply I can send now (please tweak for public-friendly tone):
"Thanks — our rerank endpoint enforces per-request input limits to protect service stability. Your request exceeded the per-request limits (documents: 140, total characters: ~120k). Workarounds: split the document set into batches of <=100 items and call /v1/rerank for each batch, then merge results client-side (preserve original indices and use a stable sort by score). Alternatively, shorten passages or pre-filter less relevant docs. Chunking can slightly alter rankings if you depend on cross-document signals; we can help with examples for Node/Python. If you believe this is an error, please attach a minimal repro payload and we will review for a quota adjustment."

sophie_engineer: Add a single-line note re: merging: keep original indices and when you combine batches, stable-sort by score and, for ties, prefer lower original index so behavior is deterministic.

qa_jordan: Repro snippet customers can run:
```
# payload.json contains ~140 items
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d @payload.json
# returns 413; gateway logs show RERANK_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE with counts
```

ashwin_infra: Proposed infra change (low-risk gateway patch): return 413 with JSON body like {"error":"RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE","doc_count":"140","chars_total":"120456","limits":{"doc_count":"100","chars_total":"100000"}}. We'll actually flatten limits as strings to keep schema simple in the gateway. This gives immediate actionable feedback without changing HTTP code path.

sophie_engineer: Also create KB with auto-chunk helper and merge example (Node & Python), plus an SDK helper suggestion to auto-chunk for common languages.

deploy-bot: deploy/infra-gateway #342 queued by @ashwin_infra — patch: include structured JSON body for rerank 413

evan_support: Good. Please post final support-safe copy and KB link once merged so I can update the customer. I'll send the chunking workaround now and offer to help with sample code. ETA? :thumbsup:

ashwin_infra: PR + unit tests targeted EOD today; canary tomorrow. Product will review per-customer caps for Dedicated/Enterprise next sprint (ticket PROD-890). I'll ping with PR link.

sophie_engineer: One more for the support reply: include a short note about potential perf trade-offs — smaller batches reduce per-call latency but may increase total calls; suggest batch sizes of 50-100 depending on avg passage length.

evan_support: Added. I'll follow up when infra patches are staged. Closing once gateway returns structured error and KB is live.
